title: Units and axis conventions (REP 103)
keywords: unit units si metre meter radian radians degree degrees axis axes right-handed enu forward left up optical
text: ROS uses SI units: metres, seconds, kilograms and radians, so velocities are m/s and rad/s. Body frames are right-handed with x forward, y left and z up; geographic frames use ENU (x east, y north, z up). Camera optical frames, whose names end in _optical, use z forward, x right and y down. A value that looks 57 times too large is usually degrees where radians are expected, and a robot that turns or drifts the wrong way often has a swapped or left-handed axis in a driver.
